// diagnostic

E1293

Lint `{name}` (`{code}`) is denied by policy: {what_text}

What

Lint `{name}` (`{code}`) is denied by policy: {what_text}

Why

{why_text}. This team's `policy.lints.deny` in `package.jet` turns this warning into a build failure; it stays a warning everywhere `package.jet` doesn't opt in. The listed lint name matches.

Fix

Use the underlying lint fix ({fix_text}), or remove `{name}` from `policy.lints.deny` if this team no longer wants the wall.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1293: tests/ui/lint_policy_l0302/stderr.

Error [jet.DeniedLint]: Lint `same_enum_guard_table` (`L0302`) is denied by policy: These arm heads all dispatch on `Choice`
  --> tests/ui/lint_policy_l0302/run.jet:8:5
    |
  8 |     if {
    |     ^^
 Why: Naming the subject makes one closed enum's cases explicit and exhaustively checked. This team's `policy.lints.deny` in `package.jet` turns this warning into a build failure; it stays a warning everywhere `package.jet` doesn't opt in. The listed lint name matches.
 Fix: Use the underlying lint fix (Write `if choice == { ... }` and put each variant pattern in an arm), or remove `same_enum_guard_table` from `policy.lints.deny` if this team no longer wants the wall.
